title: King Chulalongkorn Memorial Building

buildingCutout.basis: Named native outline of the memorial pavilion and plinth.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged regional terrain at the approach immediately outside the modeled plinth.

mapIdentity.scope: Named native OpenStreetMap envelope, the original approach relief grid, two public-domain Qualla views and the municipality’s official pavilion interpretation.

note: The map fixes an approximately 16.3 by 14.1 metre envelope. Two cleared photographs fix the white column arcade, raised gray stone terrace, red cross-gables, gold bargeboards, and multiple gold stages supporting the tall royal spire.
